tools.name: search_clubs
tools.description: Find Compteam clubs by name to get the branch_slug the public tools need. Lists only clubs with a public schedule.

tools.name: list_public_classes
tools.description: Show a club's public class schedule for one week, e.g. to find a free class's occurrence_key. Not for booking or paying for a paid class.

tools.name: list_public_membership_plans
tools.description: Show a club's active membership plans and prices. Information only: never present it as a way to sign up or pay.

tools.name: get_public_branch_details
tools.description: Show a club's public profile, address, policies, and booking, landing-page and registration links. Information only: no checkout.

tools.name: connect_compteam_account
tools.description: Start Compteam sign-in. Use when a member, child, RSVP, trial, registration or staff tool needs an account.

tools.name: list_my_subjects
tools.description: List the signed-in member's own profile and linked children with their clubs, to get branch_id and child_id for member tools.

tools.name: list_my_classes
tools.description: Show upcoming classes for the signed-in member or a linked child in one of their clubs. Not for children who are not linked to the account.

tools.name: get_account_status
tools.description: Show limited membership and payment status for the signed-in member or a linked child. Not for looking up other members.

tools.name: set_class_rsvp
tools.description: Confirm or cancel the member's or a linked child's RSVP for one class; this can move the waitlist. Never without the user's confirmation.

tools.name: show_free_trial_form
tools.description: Open the free-trial inquiry form for a free, available class. Not for paid classes or classes that are full.

tools.name: submit_free_trial_inquiry
tools.description: Send a free-trial inquiry for a free class after the user confirms the details. Not for paid classes; never resend an inquiry the user already sent.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
